name: Tra mat ong gung
summary: Trà mật ong gừng is the cup Vietnam Tourism pours in the Thới Sơn orchard, from local honey. A Zing account says the hives on Lân and on Phụng use longan blossom. A recipe for the cup was not printed.
origin: Cù lao Thới Sơn. Vietnam Tourism names Thới Sơn honey as an OCOP product and the ginger honey tea in the orchard.
howToEat: Drink it in the orchard, with the fruit and the music, on the Vietnam Tourism rural page.
A Zing account says the hives on Lân and Phụng take longan blossom. Lân is Thới Sơn. Phụng is the Ben Tre bank.
A price was not printed. The price is Check on arrival. An hour was not printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
